info.title: pz
info.description: PipelineZ (pz): a lightweight, developer-first batch data pipeline engine for SQL-based ETL/ELT, powered by DuckDB, that can run anywhere without requiring a data platform. Describe your pipeline in plain SQL files. Bundles connectors for local files, S3, Azure Blob, Google Cloud Storage, Postgres, SQL Server, MySQL, SQLite, DuckDB, DuckLake, Quack, MotherDuck and HTTP.

commands.name: cdc
commands.description: Inspect and tear down server-side change-capture (cdc) state

commands.name: drop
commands.description: Drop server-side change-capture state for ONE cdc dataset and clear pz's sync-state entry for it (in whichever store `state:` resolved to), so the next run re-snapshots.

arguments.name: TARGET
arguments.description: The cdc dataset to drop, as <source>.<dataset> (exactly one required -- no bulk drop)

commands.name: status
commands.description: Report server-side change-capture state for every cdc dataset in the project. Exit 0 when every reported dataset is healthy, 1 when any is unhealthy.

commands.name: clean
commands.description: Reclaim disk from .pz/runs. By default deletes staging.duckdb from every run but the newest, keeping every run_results.json. Never touches .pz/state, .pz/target, or .pz/packages.

options.name: --keep-last
options.description: Keep the newest N runs (default: 1). 0 selects every run, including the newest.

options.name: --older-than
options.description: Select runs older than a duration like 30m, 12h, or 7d. The newest run is kept regardless.

options.name: --purge
options.description: Delete whole run directories instead of only staging.duckdb

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print what would be deleted, and delete nothing

options.name: --select

commands.name: test

arguments.name: TARGET

options.description: Which built-in template to scaffold (default: minimal). `pz init --list-templates` shows them all [default: minimal]

options.name: --select
options.description: dbt-style node selector expression restricting which nodes are processed

commands.description: Serve this project to AI agents over the Model Context Protocol (stdio)

options.name: --allow-run

commands.name: init
commands.description: Write MCP client config files (merge-preserving) and install the pz-pipelines skill, for one or more AI clients (vscode, claude-code, copilot-cli, opencode)

options.name: --allow-run
options.description: Bake --allow-run into every generated pz server entry, so the connected client also gets pz_run/pz_retry/pz_run_results

options.name: --skill-locations
options.description: Comma-separated skill install locations (standard|claudecode|github|opencode), or all|none (default: standard plus the locations implied by the chosen clients)

arguments.name: CLIENTS
arguments.description: vscode | claude-code | copilot-cli | opencode (one or more)

commands.name: plan
commands.description: Show the per-node execution strategy (native scan/copy vs. the universal batch path) the engine would use, and why; writes .pz/target/plan.json (always full-project -- names/--select/--all filter only the printed rows).

options.name: --select
options.description: dbt-style node selector expression restricting which nodes are processed

options.name: --all
options.description: Select the whole project (required for bare `pz run` when the project has 2+ independent flows)

options.name: --no-lock-check
options.description: Skip pz.lock.json drift verification against project.yml (loud bypass; does not skip a missing lock)

arguments.name: NAMES
arguments.description: Flow name(s): filter the printed table to each node plus every ancestor and descendant

commands.name: restore
commands.description: Resolve declared non-builtin connectors against the host feeds (--feeds, else PZ_FEEDS, else nuget.org), materialize them under .pz/packages, and write pz.lock.json.

options.name: --feeds
options.description: NuGet feed URL or local folder path, in probe order; repeatable. Overrides PZ_FEEDS; default nuget.org.

commands.name: retry
commands.description: Re-run the last run's failed and skipped nodes (plus required ancestors) against the current project. No --select/--vars: retry re-runs the prior intent verbatim.

options.name: --fail-fast
options.description: Cancel remaining nodes as soon as one fails

options.name: --full-refresh
options.description: Ignore stored watermarks when reading incremental datasets this run -- capture and watermark advancement still run, re-establishing them from the full extract.

options.name: --no-lock-check
options.description: Skip pz.lock.json drift verification against project.yml (loud bypass; does not skip a missing lock)

options.name: --log-format
options.description: Output format: text (default) or json (NDJSON, one object per run event)

options.name: --otel-endpoint
options.description: OTLP/grpc collector endpoint (absolute http(s) URL); falls back to PZ_OTEL_ENDPOINT

options.name: --state-url
options.description: Run-scoped http state endpoint (absolute http(s) URL); outranks project.yml state: and PZ_STATE_*; bearer token still from PZ_STATE_TOKEN

commands.name: run
commands.description: Execute a flow end-to-end: load sources, run pipelines and checks, write sinks. `pz run <name>` runs the flow through that node; with 2+ independent flows, bare `pz run` is an error (PZ0215) -- name a flow, use --select, or pass --all.

options.name: --fail-fast
options.description: Cancel remaining nodes as soon as one fails

options.name: --full-refresh
options.description: Ignore stored watermarks and sync state when reading incremental/sync datasets this run -- capture and advancement still run, re-establishing them from the full extract.

options.name: --select
options.description: dbt-style node selector expression restricting which nodes are processed

options.name: --all
options.description: Select the whole project (required for bare `pz run` when the project has 2+ independent flows)

options.name: --no-lock-check
options.description: Skip pz.lock.json drift verification against project.yml (loud bypass; does not skip a missing lock)

options.name: --log-format
options.description: Output format: text (default) or json (NDJSON, one object per run event)

options.name: --otel-endpoint
options.description: OTLP/grpc collector endpoint (absolute http(s) URL); falls back to PZ_OTEL_ENDPOINT

options.name: --state-url
options.description: Run-scoped http state endpoint (absolute http(s) URL); outranks project.yml state: and PZ_STATE_*; bearer token still from PZ_STATE_TOKEN

arguments.name: NAMES
arguments.description: Flow name(s): each runs that node plus every ancestor and descendant (the whole flow through it)

commands.name: schema
commands.description: Inspect and accept observed schema drift for contract-less datasets

commands.name: accept
commands.description: Accept the latest run's observed schema for one or more datasets as the new baseline. Never contacts the source -- it only reads the latest run's recorded observed_schema and the current baseline.

arguments.name: TARGETS
arguments.description: One or more <connection>.<entity> datasets to accept (default: every dataset the latest run recorded an observed schema for whose baseline differs from it)

commands.name: state
commands.description: Inspect and repair watermark state in .pz/state

commands.name: clear
commands.description: Remove a stored watermark entirely, so the next run extracts that dataset in full. The only remedy for an entry whose cursor type pz has no arithmetic for.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print what would change, and change nothing

options.name: --yes
options.description: Skip the confirmation prompt (required when not on a TTY)

commands.name: rollback
commands.description: Roll a stored watermark back to the value a named prior run advanced it to. Backward only — use pz state set to move one forward.

options.name: --to-run
options.description: The run whose recorded watermark becomes the new value — pick one from pz state show <key>

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print what would change, and change nothing

options.name: --yes
options.description: Skip the confirmation prompt (required when not on a TTY)

arguments.name: KEY
arguments.description: The <source>.<dataset> whose watermark to roll back

commands.name: set
commands.description: Set a stored watermark's value directly, in either direction. Existing entries only — the cursor column and type are inherited, so this cannot invent an entry.

options.name: --value
options.description: The new cursor value. Canonicalized against the stored cursor type.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print what would change, and change nothing

options.name: --yes
options.description: Skip the confirmation prompt (required when not on a TTY)

commands.name: show
commands.description: Report stored watermark and sync state. With a key, add that dataset's run-by-run history and any manual changes. Exit 1 when a state file is corrupt.

arguments.name: KEY
arguments.description: A single <source>.<dataset> to detail, with its run history (default: list everything)
